title: Name the tick gate and wave gate in agent-runner.md
description:
Define the two gates once in skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md and use the names throughout that file, except the "Implementer prompt template" and "Warm-chain prompt variant" sections (T3 owns those).

- Place one definition of the tick gate and the wave gate next to "Post-merge verification (serial venue)" or the profile's venue text. Say how the gates relate to venues: anything a venue routes post-merge belongs to the wave gate.
- Put the by-path rule inside the tick gate definition. A test that reads a source file by path, not by import, escapes changed-file test selection. After editing a file that tests read by path, the implementer runs that package's tests whole.
- Write the regenerate-once rule into the wave-end text: loop step 4f/4h and the "Verify the wave after merging" paragraph. Shared generated outputs (screenshots, baselines, built assets) are regenerated once, by the integrator, after the merge, and once per chain for a chain.
- Use the gate names in the loop steps 4e-4f, "Post-merge verification", the run-start Testing bullet, "Integrating finished work" step 3, the warm-chain bullet in "Dispatch modes", and the DONE row of the status table.

Spec (source of truth): docs/thoughts/2026-11-12-lean-epics.md. Edit only files under skills/ticks/ (never an installed copy). Settled names, use exactly: the "tick gate" (per tick, in the worktree, run by the implementer: typecheck, the tests the change reaches, the build) and the "wave gate" (per wave, or per chain integration, run by the integrator: the full suite, slow suites, specs, shared generated outputs regenerated once). The existing in-worktree/post-merge "venues" stay: a venue says where a test tier is safe to run; the gates say who runs what, when. Add no new config syntax: `## Testing` may group commands under the two gate names in prose; the project maps commands to gates. Keep the engine voice: terse, no step lists where a criterion will do.

acceptance_criteria:
- Tick gate and wave gate are each defined once in agent-runner.md, with their relation to venues; every section listed in the description uses the names
- `grep -n 'by path' skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md` hits the by-path rule; the regenerate-once rule is in the wave-end text
- Outside the template sections, no sentence tells an implementer to run the full suite or a slow tier
